g.text: Lazy best-first extraction: enumerate ALL derivations (the no-miss heart)
[until Done(completeness) — EXHAUSTION, not a top-N cap]
materialize: pull each child's rankₖ-th best (internal lazy product)
No-miss + no-prune: the stream is COMPLETE. Pulled to
exhaustion it yields EVERY derivation of q — weight ORDERS
the stream, it never PRUNES. The only exclusions are
dropped). `kth(q, k)` is the indexed-access sibling of this
same iterator — not a separate, truncating top-N path.
